notes: Robust stability hotfix. Replaces the brittle V4.2.2 function-body patching that caused an indentation rollback with additive overrides that leave the working V4.2.1 source structure intact. Includes longer 503/429/5xx OpenAI retry backoff, website-to-Facebook business-page fallback, one-company AI qualification through the resilient pipeline, and Smart Finder resume support for paused or safely stopped sessions. The installer compiles the fully patched server before replacing the working app and rolls back automatically if validation fails.
